title: SkinBlink
description: A client-side Fabric mod that adds customizable blinking animations to Minecraft skins with an easy-to-use eye editor and skin-based blink colors.
body:
# SkinBlink

Bring your Minecraft character to life with customizable blinking animations!

SkinBlink is a client-side Fabric mod that adds realistic blinking animations to Minecraft player skins. Select your eye pixels, customize how your character blinks, and make your skin feel more alive during gameplay, cinematics, screenshots, roleplay, and Replay Mod recordings.

# ⚠️ Important Notes

* Note: This mod is NOT WORKING in REPLAY MOD!
* Currently supports Minecraft **1.21.11** only.
* Client-side only. No server installation required.
* Works with Premium Minecraft accounts.
* Works with launcher-provided and custom skins.
* Currently does **NOT** support default offline Minecraft skins such as **Steve** and **Alex**.
* Currently does **NOT** support official Minecraft skins when using offline/cracked mode.
* Offline skin support may be added in a future update.

# Features

* Custom blinking animations
* Eye pixel selection editor
* Blink color selection directly from your skin
* In-game GUI editor
* Head preview and editing canvas
* Adjustable blink timing
* Save and load blink configurations
* Replay Mod friendly
* Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
* Easy-to-use editor accessible in-game

# How To Use

1. Open the SkinBlink editor.
2. Select the pixels that represent your eyes.
3. Choose a blink color from your skin.
4. Save your configuration.
5. Enable blinking.
6. Enjoy a more alive-looking Minecraft character!

# Compatibility

### Supported

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer (Client-Side Only)
* Premium Minecraft skins
* Custom launcher skins

### Not Currently Supported

* Default offline Steve skins
* Default offline Alex skins
* Official Minecraft skins in offline/cracked mode

# Known Issues

* Default offline skins (Steve/Alex) do not currently support blinking.
* Official Minecraft skins may not work correctly in offline/cracked mode.
* Some custom skin providers may require additional testing.
